description: (needs account token) Links an HTTPS backend hosted on AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean or your own server to a DropTheHassle name. url is an HTTPS origin with no path, port 443, and a hostname that has an IPv4 address. Paths pass through unchanged. With uploaded files, only the path rules (default /api/*) go to the backend and the rest is served from the files. Without uploaded files, the whole site comes from the backend. Without site, a new site is created in the account. With site, the site is already on the account. An empty url with site removes the link. confirm=true applies a change to an existing site. A new site does not use confirm. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies a change to an existing site. False leaves that site unchanged and the reply describes the change.

paths.description: Optional path rules for split mode, e.g. ["/api/*", "/webhooks/*"]. Default ["/api/*"].

site.description: Optional address of an existing site to link, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app. Absent creates a new site served fully from the backend.

slug.description: Optional address label for a NEW site, e.g. "myapp" -> myapp.dropthehassle.app. Errors when taken.

url.description: The HTTPS origin of the backend, e.g. "https://api.example.com". Empty string (with site) unlinks.

name: set_backend
title: Connect backend
